summary: Records governance concept requiring assessor records to be retained and disposed of under approved schedules, with pending legal action, audit, records requests, or appeals overriding ordinary disposition timing.
plain_language: Do not throw away assessor records just because the normal retention period passed if an appeal, audit, request, or legal issue is still alive.

relationships.note: Appeal records must be preserved through final resolution.
Property-record data is a retention and audit trail domain.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska Secretary of State Records Management Division, Schedule 14 County Assessors (Aug. 22, 2022).
